sources.snippet: scimt-dispatch-final-v1 Research artifacts from the Dispatch final-v1 run: a three-arm midtraining study on gemma-3-12b-pt asking whether a prior installed during midtraining survives downstream instruct-training and adversarial fine-tuning, and whether it survives a change of surface form.

sources.title: AI Governance Taskforce - Arcadia Impact
sources.snippet: Our AI Governance Taskforce is a 12 week, remote (global), part-time (8 hrs/wk) research programme for experienced professionals working to reduce catastrophic risks, acute and systemic, from advanced AI through policy and governance research. The programme is designed to be compatible with existing commitments.

sources.title: Arcadia Impact
sources.snippet: Launched in May 2026, the Arcadia Alignment team is a London-based research group working in close collaboration with the UK AI Security Institute's Alignment team.
